title: Pokemon Red Tactics
author: PRed_Tactics
selftext:
AI assisted ROM hack of Pokemon Red featuring 3v3 tactics style grid battles.  
[https://pokered-tactics.com/](https://pokered-tactics.com/)

The website has a spot for players to upload their Hall of Fame teams, which can then be downloaded onto other people's .sav files in order to be challenged within their own game.

Niche, I know, but it's something I wanted to see in the world.

comments.author: sunsparkswift
comments.body:
This is really cool, and something I dreamed of seeing as a kid! And it's clear you put some considerable thought into how the battle system would translate over. I like how gust (and I'd presume other moves) moves the Pokemon it hits backwards.

Not sure if you intended it to be harder difficulty, but I somehow lost the rival battle for the first time ever lol. I probably should have used Growl at range before spamming scratch like I normally do. But I like the fact that it's a bit more difficult. I do feel like it might end up with ranged moves having a significant advantage in the later game, but it's not like the original Pokemon Red had every move as equal ether.

Also, I can confirm it works on original hardware, at least the first part does, so that's nice!

replies.author: PRed_Tactics
replies.body:
Thank you for the feedback! Yes, it's designed with the difficulty ticked up a bit. Every boss fight is like a puzzle to figure out.

I simulated hundreds of battles and reiterated the moves and systems to make sure that one strategy doesn't overwhelm the others. The move Psychic was so strong naturally that I had to nerf it by making it unusable when a foe is adjacent to the user AND the user needs to stand still on its turn.
